subject.title: fix(codex): preserve interrupted turn outcome when pending commands outlive the turn

question: Should a Codex `interrupted` terminal status suppress the synthesized missing-tool prompt error by itself, or only when OpenClaw also marked the run aborted?
rationale: Current main and this branch intentionally choose different session-terminal semantics, and the branch's narrower case is neither directly proven live nor resolvable without the required pinned Codex source inspection.

options.title: Keep Current Main
options.body: Retain the merged rule treating Codex `interrupted` as an authoritative interruption outcome and close this narrower branch as superseded.

options.title: Adopt Abort-Only Gating
options.body: Require OpenClaw's abort marker and treat other interrupted turns with pending commands as errors after exact-path live and upstream-contract proof.

recommendation.title: Keep Current Main
recommendation.body: Retain the merged rule treating Codex `interrupted` as an authoritative interruption outcome and close this narrower branch as superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged fix currently defines the exact projector behavior this PR proposes to narrow.
